scientific_integrity: The lower bound uses exhaustive integer checks over 168 increasing four-coordinate Boolean functions and 28,224 ordered pairs; witness reachability and counts are independently specified and replayed. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Five is the minimum number of deletable taxa in a rooted reachability food web for two strict joint-survival covariance sign reversals under uniform fixed-cardinality deletion. The two focal taxa and root are never selected for primary removal. No general theorem for larger webs, dynamic predictions or historical priority beyond inspected sources is asserted.
title: Five removable taxa are necessary and sufficient for two covariance reversals in a rooted food web
